description: AlphaFold pLDDT and helix profiles for the four kinesin-2 motor subunits to locate neck coil, elbow and CC2
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
def afdb(acc):
    j=requests.get(f"https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/{acc}",timeout=90).json()
    pdb=requests.get(j[0]["pdbUrl"],timeout=120).text
    return j[0], pdb
three2one = {'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I',
'LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V'}
def parse_pdb(pdb):
    rec=[]
    for l in pdb.split("\n"):
        if l.startswith("ATOM"):
            rec.append(dict(atom=l[12:16].strip(), resn=l[17:20].strip(), resi=int(l[22:26]),
                            x=float(l[30:38]), y=float(l[38:46]), z=float(l[46:54]), b=float(l[60:66])))
    return pd.DataFrame(rec)
def helix_frac(ca):
    """DSSP-free helix detector: i to i+4 CA distance ~6.2 A in an alpha helix"""
    X=ca[["x","y","z"]].values; n=len(X)
    h=np.zeros(n,bool)
    for i in range(n-4):
        d=np.linalg.norm(X[i]-X[i+4])
        if 5.0<d<6.8: h[i:i+5]=True
    return h
res={}
for acc,lab in [("Q19633","KLP-11"),("Q965T6","KLP-20"),("O15066","KIF3B"),("Q9Y496","KIF3A")]:
    meta,pdb=afdb(acc)
    df=parse_pdb(pdb); ca=df[df.atom=="CA"].sort_values("resi").reset_index(drop=True)
    ca["helix"]=helix_frac(ca); ca["seq"]=ca.resn.map(three2one)
    res[lab]=ca
    print(f"{lab} ({acc}) AFDB model v{meta.get('latestVersion')} length {len(ca)} mean pLDDT {ca.b.mean():.1f}")
# locate long helical runs beyond the motor domain
motor_end={"KLP-11":351,"KLP-20":339,"KIF3B":348,"KIF3A":353}
print("\nHelical segments C-terminal to the motor domain (>=10 residues), with mean pLDDT:")
for lab,ca in res.items():
    h=ca.helix.values; r=ca.resi.values; b=ca.b.values
    segs=[];i=0
    while i<len(h):
        if h[i]:
            j=i
            while j+1<len(h) and h[j+1]: j+=1
            if r[j]-r[i]>=9 and r[i]>motor_end[lab]-5: segs.append((r[i],r[j],b[i:j+1].mean()))
            i=j+1
        else: i+=1
    print(f"  {lab}: "+"; ".join(f"{a}-{c} (pLDDT {m:.0f})" for a,c,m in segs))

fig,axes=plt.subplots(4,1,figsize=(12,8),sharex=False)
for ax,(lab,ca) in zip(axes,res.items()):
    ax.plot(ca.resi,ca.b,lw=0.9,color="#2F6FC2")
    ax.fill_between(ca.resi,0,100,where=ca.helix,color="#F0C06A",alpha=0.35,step="mid")
    ax.axvspan(1,motor_end[lab],color="#B9C6D9",alpha=0.35)
    ax.set_ylim(0,100); ax.set_ylabel("pLDDT",fontsize=8); ax.set_title(lab,fontsize=9,loc="left")
    ax.tick_params(labelsize=8)
axes[-1].set_xlabel("residue",fontsize=9)
fig.suptitle("AlphaFold per-residue confidence and helix assignment: blue block = motor domain, orange = helix\n"
             "low-pLDDT troughs between helical runs mark the elbow/hinge regions",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
